Elemental Pickup Interactions grant <pve #e${30*#d}% /> <pvp [#e${10*#d}%] /> increased damage for a variable duration based on the pickup. Can be activated while stowed.

<arc/>Ionic Traces, <stasis/>Stasis Shards, and <strand/>Tangle Detonations grant the buff for 4 seconds. Throwing a held <strand/>Tangle grants 4 additional seconds. <solar/>Firesprites and <void/>Void Breaches grant the buff for 8 seconds.

Additional Pickups can extend the duration up to the maximum of 16 seconds.

Elemental Pickup Interactions:
• Destroying a <strand/>Tangle (or Elemental Orbs), either by shooting or throwing.
• Collecting <solar/>Firesprites, <arc/>Ionic Traces, <stasis/>Stasis Shards, or <void/>Void Breaches

Does not trigger with <stasis/>Stasis Shards generated from Facet of Awakening or Facet of Command.
